[[Mical]] constructed a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] of '''his own design''' after he became a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] sometime after the [[First Jedi Purge]] following the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3951 BBY]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], this holocron was discovered.
